column1: # The FerroPIX population of the demo, read by seed/ferropix.sh. Every name,
# address, number and BSN is invented; each BSN passes the eleven-proof. The
# group says what the seed does with a row: `single` and `bsn-link` records
# feed the index (a shared BSN links), the pair groups give the review queue
# its grades, `decide-*` and `merge-*` pairs are decided or merged by the
# steward, and `hl7v2` rows arrive from hospital E over MLLP. `-` is absent.
